segments.he: ועמד מהעגלה ורתם את סוסיו וכבר פתחו את החצר ונסע עם העגלה שלו (כי בבוקר שהולכים אנשים הליכה וחזרה אין להם שליטה לעכב איש ולרצות להרגו כי יכול לעשות צעקה ושיבא הממשלה וכו') והבע"ב נכנס וראה שהאיש שהרג הוא בנו ונעשה אצלם אבל ויללה ומר ומרור וחושך וצלמוות כן יאבדו כל אויבך ה' ואוהביו כצאת השמש בגבורתו אכי"ר.
segments.en: "My husband the holy Tzaddik Reb Simcha once traveled on a journey and was delayed about two weeks. He told me he would return home for Shabbos. On that very Shabbos he had promised to return, I rose before dawn to knead the holy challahs for Shabbos. While separating the challah portion I searched to see where he was — to know whether he would come home for Shabbos [for she was among those with prophetic gifts, as is known — her brother the holy Reb Baruch of Medzhibuzh called her a prophetess, and her holy brothers Reb Baruch and Reb Ephraim of Sadilkov showed her great reverence]. But I could not find him. Afterward when I did other Shabbos preparations, I searched again and could not find him — and so it was many times. [That night was also the night of her immersion. She considered whether to go, went, and searched then too — and could not find him.] And when I lit the Shabbos candles [it was her custom to light many hours before the required time], I searched again and could not see him. After lighting the candles I lay down on my bed from great distress — and dozed off."
